model_version_pinning: API accepts the mutable alias deepseek-flash; record response.model and system_fingerprint on every request and detect backend drift.

network.note: Configure a dedicated DeepSeek HTTP client with trust_env=false. Do not change global proxy settings.

token_cap_per_request.enforcement: DeepSeekClient uses the pinned DeepSeek V4.1 tokenizer when tokenizer_path is supplied, counts the serialized request, and adds a fixed 8-token margin. Without tokenizer_path it fails closed with a UTF-8 byte upper bound.

budget_enforcement.episode_budget: request, input-token, output-token, and cost caps are keyed by episode_id
budget_enforcement.request_count_semantics: RequestBudget counters reserve physical attempts: each logical request reserves max_retries + 1 before sending.
budget_enforcement.note: All five clients (four distinct module clients plus one User Simulator client) must share the same RequestBudget object. These are conservative reservation caps for the 64-episode smoke.

pricing_verification.peak_hours_utc: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00, Monday-Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays
pricing_verification.budget_basis: Peak rates and cache-miss input pricing; conservative upper bound independent of run time/cache hit rate.
pricing_verification.note: Public docs rechecked 2026-11-23; prices unchanged. Recheck again immediately before any paid run. Actual account response model/fingerprint remains unverified.

user_simulator_preflight.note: The adapter and five-client smoke factory are implemented and no-API tested. All five clients share one RequestBudget and one ModelFingerprintTracker while remaining distinct objects.

request_count_basis.note: Tau2FourModuleAgent invokes Planner + Selector + exactly one of Caller/Synthesizer for each Agent response. Tau2 Orchestrator max_steps is a bound on half-duplex transitions; using 30 Agent and 30 User responses is a conservative upper bound.

retail_task_5.risk: Retail tools do not enforce authenticated-user state before get_user_details/get_order_details. The domain policy requires authentication. Task 5 reward_basis is DB + NL_ASSERTION, not ACTION, so ENV reward does not guarantee authentication-sequence compliance.
retail_task_5.limitation: Do not claim authentication, privacy, or policy-enforcement robustness from this task. Record authentication sequence as a diagnostic only. Do not patch or replace the pinned task.
